Developer tooling: doctor, gates, and atomic install/verify

Usage: sddk dev <COMMAND>

Commands:
  doctor              Check the toolchain and environment prerequisites
  check               Run repository quality gates (fmt, clippy, tests)
  install             Install this binary atomically into a prefix with a receipt
  verify              Verify an installed prefix against its receipt
  uninstall           Remove an installed prefix only when it matches its receipt
  link                Symlink the framework assets (agents/skills/prompts/workflows) into an editor
  use                 Select the active framework bundle version (asdf-style `use`)
  manifest            Generate or verify MANIFEST.sha256 — per-file content hashes of the framework surfaces (agents, skills, prompts, workflows, assets)
  check-architecture  Evaluate architecture rules against the live workspace baseline
  update              Install a framework release bundle (download, verify checksum + internal MANIFEST.sha256, extract). Never touches git — source checkouts are managed by the developer (`git pull` + `dev link`)
  projection          Projection rebuild and inspection tooling
  models              Manage agent-models.yaml (list/set/validate) and locate the TUI
  entropy             Multidimensional architecture health report (LOC, coupling, fan-in/out)
  reconcile           Reconcile IDE agent configs with bundle sources (dry-run by default)
  voice               Voice profile management (list/show/set overrides per agent)
  skills              Inspect the runtime skill registry that the M7.7 CLI runner gate consults (list loaded skills, verify declared required skills against the bundle)
  graph               Inspect the M8 (H9 Active Graph & Cockpit) engine projection: list nodes, list typed edges, or emit the full `ActiveGraphProjection` as JSON. Closes the M8.0 surface — the engine module was already shipped but had no operator-facing entry point
  cockpit             Inspect the M8 (H9 Cockpit Views) engine: render structural / temporal views (overview, journal, timeline, execution) over the projected active graph. Closes the M8.2 surface
  test                Test tooling (count-workspace)
  lint                Architecture lint registry executors (M0 D6 / M9 enforcement infrastructure)
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
